Run S3-CIMA

Main function to run S3-CIMA. See README for usage instructions

s3cima.s3cima.run_s3cima(anchor: str, image_id, sample_id, intensity, genes, cell_type, x, y, cell_id, label, label_map, K: int = 50, ncell: int = 30, random_ctrl: bool = True, task: str = 'classification', nruns: int = 5, dendrogram_cutoff: float = 0.4, n_val_folds: int = 3, maxpool_percentages: list = (0.01, 1, 5, 20, 100), nfilter_selection: list = (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10), filter_threshold: float = 0.9, dropout: bool = True, dropout_p: float = 0.5, bg_sets: int = 500, batch_size=256, lr: float = 0.1, l2: float = 0.0001, epochs: int = 20, num_workers: int = 0, early_stopping=True, patience: int = 3, seed: int = 420, save_path: str = '.')[source]

Run a full S3-CIMA analysis.

Builds multi-cell input sets from the spatial neighborhoods of an anchor cell type, trains the S3-CIMA weakly supervised convolutional neural network to predict the sample-level outcome, and identifies the cell populations (filters) whose neighborhood composition is associated with that outcome. Filter weights, high-response cells, enrichment statistics and summary plots are written to disk for both the training and test sets.

Parameters:

  • anchor (str) -- Cell type used as the anchor. Neighborhoods are built around cells of this type.

  • image_id (array-like of shape (n_cells,)) -- Image (region of interest) identifier for each cell.

  • sample_id (array-like of shape (n_cells,)) -- Sample or patient identifier for each cell. Outcome labels are defined at this level.

  • intensity (array-like of shape (n_cells, n_markers)) -- Marker expression intensities for each cell.

  • genes (list of str) -- Marker names, in the same order as the columns of intensity.

  • cell_type (array-like of shape (n_cells,)) -- Cell type annotation for each cell.

  • x (array-like of shape (n_cells,)) -- Spatial x coordinate of each cell.

  • y (array-like of shape (n_cells,)) -- Spatial y coordinate of each cell.

  • cell_id (array-like of shape (n_cells,)) -- Unique identifier for each cell.

  • label (array-like of shape (n_cells,)) -- Outcome label (e.g. disease condition) of the sample each cell belongs to.

  • label_map (dict) -- Mapping from label values to human-readable class names, used in plots and enrichment outputs.

  • K (int, default=50) -- Number of nearest neighbors defining the spatial neighborhood around each anchor cell.

  • ncell (int, default=30) -- Number of cells in each multi-cell input set passed to the network.

  • random_ctrl (bool, default=True) -- Whether to generate random background (control) cell sets to compare against the anchor neighborhoods.

  • task (str, default="classification") -- Learning task, e.g. "classification" for categorical outcomes or regression for contiuous outcomes ("regression" mode not yet supported).

  • nruns (int, default=5) -- Number of independent training runs with different random initializations.

  • dendrogram_cutoff (float, default=0.4) -- Cutoff applied to the hierarchical clustering of learned filters across runs, used to group similar filters into consensus filters.

  • n_val_folds (int, default=3) -- Number of cross-validation folds used for model selection.

  • maxpool_percentages (list of float, default=[0.01, 1, 5, 20, 100]) -- Candidate percentages of top-responding cells pooled per filter, searched during hyperparameter selection.

  • nfilter_selection (list of int, default=[3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10]) -- Candidate numbers of convolutional filters, searched during hyperparameter selection.

  • filter_threshold (float, default=0.9) -- Threshold on the filter response above which a cell is considered a high-response cell.

  • dropout (bool, default=True) -- Whether to apply dropout during training.

  • dropout_p (float, default=0.5) -- Dropout probability, used if dropout is True.

  • bg_sets (int, default=500) -- Number of random background cell sets generated when random_ctrl is True.

  • batch_size (int, default=256) -- Training batch size.

  • lr (float, default=0.1) -- Learning rate.

  • l2 (float, default=1e-4) -- L2 regularization strength (weight decay).

  • epochs (int, default=20) -- Maximum number of training epochs.

  • num_workers (int, default=0) -- Number of worker processes for data loading.

  • early_stopping (bool, default=True) -- Whether to stop training when the validation loss stops improving.

  • patience (int, default=3) -- Number of epochs without improvement before early stopping is triggered.

  • seed (int, default=420) -- Random seed for reproducibility.

  • save_path (str, default=".") -- Directory where the trained model results, figures and enrichment statistics are saved.

Returns:

All outputs (model results, filter weight plots, high-response cell statistics and enrichment summaries for the train and test sets) are written to save_path.

Return type:

None

Examples

>>> run_s3cima(
            "BG",
            image_id,
            sample_id,
            intensity,
            genes,
            cell_type,
            x,
            y,
            cell_id,
            labels,
            label_map,
            K=50,
            ncell = 30,
            random_ctrl=False,
            n_val_folds=3,
            bg_sets=1000,    # Number of random background sets to draw from each sample/patient
            num_workers=24,
            batch_size=128,
            lr = 0.001,
            nruns=10,
            save_path = save_path,
            seed=43
            )
